item.title: Undo things by asking Murph
item.summary: Murph can now take you out of a group game, cancel a Family invite you sent, disconnect a wearable, or stop your health sharing with a group, when you ask in chat.
item.details: Before, Murph could start these but sent you to Settings to undo them. Family invites, wearables and group sharing change only when you ask in your private chat with Murph. Leaving a game works in that game's own chat.
